entries.title: Ezekiel 2:1
segments: ¶And He said to me, "Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you."

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:2
segments: Then the Spirit entered me when He spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard Him who spoke to me.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:3
segments: And He said to me: "Son of man, I am sending you to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have transgressed against Me to this very day.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:4
segments: "For [they are] impudent and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord GOD.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:5
segments: "As for them, whether they hear or whether they refuse-for they [are] a rebellious house-yet they will know that a prophet has been among them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:6
segments: ¶"And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them nor be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns [are] with you and you dwell among scorpions; do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their looks, though they [are] a rebellious house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:7
segments: "You shall speak My words to them, whether they hear or whether they refuse, for they [are] rebellious.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:8
segments: "But you, son of man, hear what I say to you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you."

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:9
segments: Now when I looked, there was a hand stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book [was] in it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:10
segments: Then He spread it before me; and [there was] writing on the inside and on the outside, and written on it [were] lamentations and mourning and woe.
